WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN brokrepstat IS NULL THEN 'NO STATUS' ELSE brokrepstat END AS status,
         AVG(modelconf) as avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as overall_average
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT sa.status, sa.avg_conf, (sa.avg_conf - oa.overall_average) as diff
  FROM status_avgs sa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE sa.avg_conf > oa.overall_average
),
mean_of_above_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_conf) as mean_qualifying
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT aa.status,
       aa.avg_conf,
       aa.diff,
       aa.avg_conf / maa.mean_qualifying as ratio
FROM above_avg aa, mean_of_above_avg maa
ORDER BY aa.status
